notes: Zapple 5.1.0: Zapple Worlds gets tools and crafting! Pickaxes, axes and shovels (wood, stone, zap, gem) that wear out, a Workbench with a 3x3 crafting grid, and real digging: stone needs a pickaxe, better ores need better tools. Fixed: you no longer sink into the ground while a world loads. Zapple Wheels and Cut the Zap are gone. Admins can update the server from the app.
